title: Experiment node
description: One participant of the emulated network. Everything the runtime needs to create the namespace, start multichaind and address it over RPC.

id.description: Stable host name. Also the directory name under logs/ and data/, and the 'host' column of every historical CSV.

hostname.description: Name used inside the emulated network. Defaults to id.

role.description: miner = wPoA validator and cluster head; company = client publishing supply-chain items; admin = governance (genesis, permissions, GAS); ca = Certification Authority (publishes ESG, holds the high1 permission). admin and ca are both administrative nodes.

organization.description: Owning organisation; free text, reported in the metrics.

location.description: Topology location id this node is attached to (topology.nodes[].id).

cluster.description: For a company: id of the miner whose cluster it joins. Ignored for other roles.

ip.description: Node address inside the emulated network. Allocated from experiment.network.subnet when omitted.

miner.description: Whether the node receives the 'mine' permission. Defaults to role == miner.

weight.description: Static fallback weight (-weight). Only honoured when the weight engine is off; see docs/metrics.md.

seed.description: Per-node seed for the workload generators. Derived from the experiment seed when omitted.

expected_state.description: State the lifecycle asserts at the end of the run. 'absent' declares a node that must never start (offline peer).

peers.description: Explicit -addnode peer list. Derived from the topology when omitted.

tx_interval_s.description: Company only: seconds between two supply-chain publications (drives tau_i).

reconcile_rate.description: Miner only: fraction of the GAS balance returned to the treasury each epoch (drives rho_k).
